Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    cols=sorted({I[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=bg})
    for col in cols:
        ps=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==col]
        # group by main diag and anti diag
        mg=defaultdict(list); ag=defaultdict(list)
        for i,j in ps:
            mg[i-j].append((i,j)); ag[i+j].append((i,j))
        for key,gps in list(mg.items())+list(ag.items()):
            if len(gps)<2: continue
            gps.sort()
            step=(gps[1][0]-gps[0][0],gps[1][1]-gps[0][1])
            cur=gps[0]
            while True:
                cur=(cur[0]+step[0],cur[1]+step[1])
                if not(0<=cur[0]<H and 0<=cur[1]<W): break
                if I[cur[0]][cur[1]]!=bg: break
                O[cur[0]][cur[1]]=col
    return O

def f2(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    cols=sorted({I[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=bg})
    for col in cols:
        ps=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==col]
        mg=defaultdict(list); ag=defaultdict(list)
        for i,j in ps:
            mg[i-j].append((i,j)); ag[i+j].append((i,j))
        for groups in [mg,ag]:
            for key,gps in groups.items():
                if len(gps)<2: continue
                gps.sort()
                for a,b in zip(gps,gps[1:]):
                    # walk between consecutive anchors
                    si=a[0]-a[1]; sj=b[0]-b[1]
                    dx=sj//max(1,abs(sj) or 1)
                    dy=(b[1]-a[1])//(abs(b[1]-a[1]) or 1)
                    x,y=a
                    while True:
                        x+=dx; y+=dy
                        if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W): break
                        if I[x][y]!=bg and I[x][y]!=col: break
                        O[x][y]=col
    return O
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    print(n, f2(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])

```python
def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts={}
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]!=bg: pts.setdefault(I[i][j],[]).append((i,j))
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    for col,ps in pts.items():
        omg=defaultdict(list); oag=defaultdict(list)
        for i,j in ps: omg[i-j].append((i,j)); oag[i+j].append((i,j))
        for groups in (omg,oag):
            for k,gps in groups.items():
                if len(gps)<2: continue
                gps.sort()
                for a,b in zip(gps,gps[1:]):
                    dx=b[0]-a[0]; dy=b[1]-a[1]
                    sx=1 if dx>0 else (-1 if dx<0 else 0)
                    sy=1 if dy>0 else (-1 if dy<0 else 0)
                    x,y=a
                    while True:
                        x+=sx; y+=sy
                        if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or I[x][y]!=bg: break
                        O[x][y]=col
    return O
```

from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]!=bg: pts[I[i][j]].append((i,j))
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    def line_key(p, typ):
        return p[0]-p[1] if typ=='main' else p[0]+p[1]
    def paint_diag(typ, cells, val):
        # fill bg cells along the diagonal defined by typ and the extreme cells of 'cells'
        cells.sort()
        a,b=cells[0],cells[-1]
        dx=b[0]-a[0]; dy=b[1]-a[1]
        sx=1 if dx>0 else -1; sy=1 if dy>0 else -1
        x,y=a
        while True:
            x+=sx; y+=sy
            if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or I[x][y]!=bg: break
            O[x][y]=val
        x,y=b
        while True:
            x-=sx; y-=sy
            if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or I[x][y]!=bg: break
            O[x][y]=val
    for c,ps in pts.items():
        ps=set(ps)
        for typ in ('main','anti'):
            g=defaultdict(list)
            for p in ps: g[line_key(p,typ)].append(p)
            for k,v in g.items():
                v.sort()
                if len(v)<2: continue
                paint_diag(typ,v,c)
    # rule2: anchor strictly between >=2 anchors of another color on a diagonal -> paint its OTHER diagonal fully (bg cells only)
    for p in pts:
        i,j=p
        for typ in ('main','anti'):
            k=line_key(p,typ)
            for c2,ps2 in pts.items():
                if c2==pts[p][0]: continue
                v=[q for q in ps2 if line_key(q,typ)==k]
                if len(v)<2: continue
                v0,v1=v[0],v[-1]
                if not (v0[0]<i<v1[0] and v0[1]<j<v1[1]): continue
                otyp=('anti' if typ=='main' else 'main')
                qts=[q for q in pts if line_key(q,otyp)==line_key(p,otyp)]
                qts.sort(); qa,qb=qts[0],qts[-1]
                dx=qb[0]-qa[0]; dy=qb[1]-qa[1]
                sx=1 if dx>0 else -1; sy=1 if dy>0 else -1
                x,y=qa
                while True:
                    x+=sx; y+=sy
                    if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or I[x][y]!=bg: break
                    O[x][y]=pts[p][0]
                x,y=qb
                while True:
                    x-=sx; y-=sy
                    if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or I[x][y]!=bg: break
                    O[x][y]=pts[p][0]
    return O
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    print(n, solve(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])
